title: OpenStreetMap: places with community accessibility tags
description: Restaurants, cafés, shops, museums, hotels, toilets, pharmacies and other places in Belgium and Hauts-de-France with OpenStreetMap's community accessibility tags: wheelchair (yes, limited, no, designated), wheelchair:description, toilets:wheelchair, hearing_loop (induction loop), ramp, step_count and more, as contributed by mappers and apps such as Wheelmap and OnWheels. Search around a point within 1 km, by kind, name and tag values. Live data; a missing tag means unknown. When OpenStreetMap's shared server is busy, calls return 503 with a retry time.
